name: Tír inna mBan
text: Tír inna mBan is a variant form of the name Tir na mBan. The dictionary prints the head as a one-line cross-reference. The record of the island of women sits under the Tir na mBan node. Both forms carry the same island of women. Readers meet either spelling in voyage tales.
